diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
index 98bf34f..32b2bd8 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
@@ -58,3 +58,46 @@ def test_enum_mappings(enum_type, naming, mapping):
     for name, val in members:
         mapped = mapping[val]
         assert camel_to_snake(naming, name) == mapped.name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("version, expected", [
+    ("6.2.2", set()),
+    ("6.2.3", {".jpg", ".jpe", ".png"}),
+    ("6.6.9", {".jpg", ".jpe", ".png"}),
+    ("6.7.0", set()),
+])
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround(monkeypatch, version, expected):
+    from qutebrowser.utils import utils
+
+    def version_check(minimum, *, compiled):
+        assert compiled is False
+        return (utils.VersionNumber.parse(version) >=
+                utils.VersionNumber.parse(minimum))
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check", version_check)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "types_map", {
+        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+        ".jpe": "image/jpeg",
+        ".png": "image/png",
+        ".mpg4": "video/mp4",
+    })
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/*", ".jpg"]) == expected - {".jpg"}
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_specific_mime(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        lambda version, *, compiled: version == "6.2.3")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: {
+                            "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+                            "video/mp4": [".m4v", ".mpg4"],
+                        }[mime])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", "video/mp4", ".jpg"]
+    ) == {".jpe", ".m4v", ".mpg4"}
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]
+    ) == set()
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround([".jpg"]) == set()
